newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks ease by midday despite fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks ease by midday despite fund buying.

text.p: A brief early morning rally of Thai stocks, helped by entry of a private market rescue fund, faded by the lunch break on sustained forced sales of shares by some indebted small investors, brokers said on Tuesday.
The SET index declined 1.53 points to 984.79 on thin 1.6 billion baht turnover by midday after it rose 1.24 points within the first half hour after opening.
"The index moved in a narrow range as forced selling seems to have reached a saturation point amid some investment by the support fund," said Songyos Kulvichien of First Asia Securities.
